## Research question / task

What specific question or deliverable will this issue resolve?

## Workstream

- [ ] C.1 Active-only classification
- [ ] C.2 No-trade counterfactual
- [ ] C.3 Performance and flows
- [ ] C.4 Provider bridge
- [ ] C.5 Distribution exposure
- [ ] C.6 Entrant selection and survival
- [ ] C.7 Russell migration

## Data and provenance

List source files, versions, dates, identifiers, and known restrictions. Do not attach private or licensed data.

## Method and assumptions

Describe the measurement, comparison, sample, denominator, and identifying assumptions.

## Acceptance tests

- [ ] Schema and key checks
- [ ] Date/as-of alignment
- [ ] Missingness, ambiguity, and exclusions reported
- [ ] Representative edge cases inspected
- [ ] Reproducible output and artifact retained
- [ ] Runtime bounded below three hours

## Falsification / limitations

What result would contradict the hypothesis? What does this task not establish?

## Expected output and next decision

Name the report, code, table, or artifact expected and the decision it should inform.
